scope: Fixed-chart bounded event likelihood representation and small falsification; not autonomous nonlinear cold start or MCU qualification.

representation.coordinates: Original global theta/alpha chart; reference scaling; carried model state and sensitivities
representation.event_policy: Seal at a change of actual current or dt, or 256 samples; merge disjoint events into one historical factor
representation.persistent_history: One aggregate plus one active event; no raw samples, input-history list or explicit Q basis
representation.exact_claim: Preserves the complete frozen affine least-squares objective, gradient and joint Gram, up to floating-point error
representation.nonlinear_claim: None without separate replay evidence; translating the polynomial is not relinearization
representation.source_policy: One fixed 256-bit caller source identity and contiguous sample counter; no posterior prior or duplicate sources
representation.noise: Known common iid1mV voltage noise; same assumptions as the retained reference

candidate_policy.radius_meaning: Declared operating restriction, not an analytical nonlinear remainder bound
candidate_policy.computed_probe: Minimum-norm fixed-affine step using existing1e-10 relative eigen cutoff; report discarded/null directions and never infer their precision
candidate_policy.physical_checks: Original parameter supports, coupled abs(u0)<=H and complete SOC path using charge extrema
candidate_policy.rejected_update: Retain original evidence and expose relinearization_required; no silent clipping, reset or prior multiplication

checks.nonlinear_probe_errors: Report every observed discrepancy; do not tune the domain to passing probes or equate radius pass with validity
checks.conditional_status: 400s Q/SOC unresolved and gamma_minus unexcited;900s Q/SOC local precision retained; tail carries previous evidence
checks.truth: Only post-inference scoring; never config, objective, chart or guard input

memory.lifetime_scaling: All bounded-core objects independent of observation/event count; uint64 exhaustion fails closed
memory.target: Approximately10KiB is an eventual subsystem goal, not an acceptance gate or attained firmware budget

frozen_evidence_policy: Read original results; write all new evidence under experiments/bounded_event_001; do not rerun60fits or profiles
